## 🎯 Summary

Describe the change and the user problem it solves.

## 🧭 Scope

- CLI behavior:
- Files changed:
- Related issue:

## 🔐 Safety and filesystem impact

Describe source/target behavior, overwrite behavior, permissions, temporary files, and partial output risks.

## 🧪 Validation

- [ ] cargo fmt --all -- --check
- [ ] cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
- [ ] cargo test
- [ ] cargo build --release

## 📚 Documentation

- [ ] README/reference docs updated.
- [ ] Flowcharts or diagrams updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] Changelog updated.

## ✅ Author checklist

- [ ] No generated build output or secrets included.
- [ ] Tests cover relevant error paths.
- [ ] No unsupported feature claims added.
